name: Hailuo AI
tagline: Hailuo AI is MiniMax's video generation platform, known for exceptionally smooth motion, realistic physics, and strong character consistency across frames. Its MiniMax Video-01 model became widely used after demonstrating quality competitive with Sora and Kling at accessible pricing. Content creators and motion graphics artists use Hailuo for polished, cinematic AI video with natural-feeling movement.
